cues: In Fresnel diffraction, the source and screen are at finite distances, the wavefronts are curved, and the mathematics is hard.
In Fraunhofer diffraction, source and screen are effectively at infinity, the wavefronts are plane, and lenses are used.
Everything in this unit is Fraunhofer: parallel light in, parallel light out, brought to a focus by a lens.
text: There are two classes. In Fresnel diffraction, the source and screen are at finite distances, the wavefronts are curved, and the mathematics is hard. In Fraunhofer diffraction, source and screen are effectively at infinity, the wavefronts are plane, and lenses are used. Everything in this unit is Fraunhofer: parallel light in, parallel light out, brought to a focus by a lens.
